blocks.text: In a rare moment, Randy Santiago, who is known for always wearing his tinted glasses, showed his eyes to the public after undergoing two surgeries for his cataracts. Santiago attended the “Goin’ Standard: The Repeat” concert of veteran actor-director Edgar “Bobot” Mortiz last Oct. 10, where he wore clear eye glasses instead of his usual heavily tinted ones.
